title: How SC-1 Cleaning (APM) Works: Removing Particles with Zeta Potential, Ammonia, and Hydrogen Peroxide [Cleaning Level 3, Lesson 3 Extra]
excerpt: Learn the history of RCA cleaning and why SC-1 can remove particles. As an extra lesson for Lesson 3 of Cleaning Level 3, this covers how RCA cleaning came about, the wafer surface after cleaning, and how today's cleaning has changed. You can also review key terms and common misconceptions.
